title: Multicenter Study for External Validation of the TB-NET Score
official: Multicentric Study for External Validation of the TB-NET Score
summary: This is a retrospective, observational, multicenter study aiming to externally validate the TB-NET Score in an independent cohort of patients with advanced well-differentiated gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs) or lung carcinoids. The primary objective is to validate the prognostic value of the TB-NET Score for progression-free survival (PFS). Secondary objectives include the evaluation of overall survival (OS), objective response rate (ORR), grade 3-4 adverse events, biochemical and functional imaging correlates, and the potential additional prognostic value of tumor growth rate (TGR).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients with histologically confirmed well differentiated advanced GEP-NETs or Lung Carcinoids starting any line of systemic therapy.
* Grade 1, 2 or 3 if well-differentiated morphology for GEP-NETs. Typical or Atypical Lung Carcinoids.
* At least one target lesion.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with Neuroendocrine Carcinomas.
* Patients with no target lesions (according to RECIST 1.1 criteria).
